items.title: Single-Stream Diffusion
items.description: The joymagic model adopts a Single-Stream Diffusion Transformer architecture. This design unifies the processing of various conditional inputs (like text and image embeddings) with the noisy image latents into a single sequence, which is then fed into the Transformer backbone.

items.description: The core few-step distillation algorithm that empowers the 8-step joymagic model. By recognizing and decoupling CFG Augmentation and Distribution Matching, we developed an improved distillation process.

items.title: DMDR

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Common questions about joymagic and its capabilities.

items.question: How does joymagic generate images?
items.answer: joymagic generates images using advanced AI models that are released under the Apache-2.0 open-source license and deployed on our optimized inference infrastructure. When you enter a text prompt, it is processed through our safety and moderation systems to ensure it meets platform guidelines. The prompt is then sent to our inference pipeline, where the model generates an image based on your description. The final output is delivered instantly to your browser. joymagic is an independent service and provides its own interface, safety layers, and performance optimizations on top of licensed open-source model components.

items.question: Is joymagic an official product of Alibaba or any AI model provider?
items.answer: No. joymagic is an independent AI image-generation service and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Alibaba Group or any other AI model provider. We deploy and optimize AI models that are released under the Apache-2.0 open-source license on our own infrastructure, and we add our own safety systems, usage controls, and interface on top. All trademarks, model names, and product names mentioned in our documentation or marketing materials belong to their respective owners. For full details, please see our AI Wrapper Disclaimer and Open-Source Attribution pages.

items.question: What happens after I enter a prompt?
items.answer: Your prompt goes through a mandatory safety moderation check. If approved, the system processes it to generate an image. If it violates our policy, it will be blocked and an alternative suggestion may be provided.

items.question: Does joymagic allow NSFW or adult content generation?
items.answer: No. joymagic strictly prohibits generating: Sexual or pornographic content, Graphic violence, Illegal or harmful activities, Copyright-violating material. All prompts are screened before processing.

items.question: What technology does joymagic use to generate results?
items.answer: joymagic uses optimized diffusion-transformer image-generation models that support fast inference, photorealistic output, and bilingual (Chinese & English) text rendering. Our interface makes these capabilities accessible to all users.

items.question: What am I paying for when I purchase credits?
items.answer: Credits represent compute usage. Each generation consumes a fixed number of credits, and you only pay for what you use. No subscription is required unless you choose one. There are no hidden fees.

items.question: Are my images or prompts used to train your models?
items.answer: No, unless you explicitly give permission. Prompts are processed only for generating your requested image and are not stored or reused for training purposes by default.

items.question: Does joymagic store any user data?
items.answer: No. joymagic does not store user prompts, generated images, or personal data unless you explicitly choose to save them in your account.

items.question: Can I delete my generated images or account data?
items.answer: Yes. If you save any images or account data voluntarily, you may delete them at any time. You may also request full data deletion by contacting support@joymagic.fun.

items.question: What happens if my prompt gets blocked by moderation?
items.answer: It means the prompt violated our safety rules. You may revise the prompt to avoid unsafe or restricted content. The system provides guidance when a prompt is blocked.

items.question: Does joymagic support editing existing images?
items.answer: Not yet. joymagic does not currently support editing uploaded images. However, our editing model (joymagic Edit) is under active development and will be released in a future update once fully tested.

items.question: How does joymagic protect user privacy?
items.answer: We follow strict privacy standards: No biometric data collection, No data sharing with third parties, Encryption of data during transfer and storage, Optional deletion of saved data and account information.

items.question: Is customer support available?
items.answer: Yes. Our support team can be reached at support@joymagic.fun, and we typically respond within 24–48 business hours.
